actions.name: create
actions.ricardian_contract:
---
title: Create token definition
---
Requires contract-account authorization. Creates the stat row for one symbol and charges RAM to the contract. It does not issue supply or create a balance. Fails for invalid or duplicate symbols and non-positive maximum supply.

actions.name: issue
actions.ricardian_contract:
---
title: Issue token supply
---
Requires issuer authorization. Increases current supply within the registered maximum and credits the issuer. When `to` differs from the issuer, the implementation transfers the quantity atomically and emits transfer notifications.

actions.name: retire
actions.ricardian_contract:
---
title: Retire token supply
---
Requires issuer authorization. Debits the issuer balance and reduces current supply atomically. Fails for invalid quantity, symbol mismatch, or insufficient issuer balance.

actions.name: transfer
actions.ricardian_contract:
---
title: Transfer tokens
---
Requires sender authorization. Debits the sender, credits the recipient, may create a recipient balance row and charge RAM, and notifies both accounts. A failing notification reverts the complete transaction.

actions.name: open
actions.ricardian_contract:
---
title: Open a token balance
---
Requires RAM-payer authorization. Creates a zero-balance row for the owner and registered symbol, charging RAM to `ram_payer`.

actions.name: close
actions.ricardian_contract:
---
title: Close an empty token balance
---
Requires owner authorization. Erases only a zero-balance row and refunds its RAM to the original payer.
